originalTitle: Will Terraform Industries begin to commercialize in 2024?
title: Terraform 会在 2024 年底前签订电转烃设备销售合同吗？
Would Terraform contract power-to-hydrocarbon equipment sales in 2024?
rules: 2024 年底前出售或签约出售/租售电转烃反应器或完整碳浓缩器，买方用途须为以烃储存太阳能；不要求当年交付。
By end-2024, sale/contract/leasing of a power-to-hydrocarbon reactor or complete concentrator for storing solar energy as hydrocarbons qualifies; delivery need not occur that year.
只卖甲烷不算设备商业化；规则也允许 2023 年提前满足，原平台判 No。
Methane-only sales do not count; earlier qualification in 2023 was allowed. The platform resolved No.
interpretation: 本题商业化指设备合同，不是首次合成甲烷或燃料销售。公司的 2024 年示范公告可说明工艺集成，但没有直接证明规则要求的机器交易。
Commercialization here means an equipment contract, not first methane or fuel sales. The 2024 demonstration explains integration without directly establishing the required machine transaction.

checklist: 辨别合同标的是燃料还是完整设备。
Identify fuel versus qualifying equipment in the contract.
核对交易双方、用途与合同时间。
Check counterparties, purpose and contract date.
分别记录示范运行、合同与实际交付。

stage: 工艺集成 → 设备订单 → 制造交付
impact: Sabatier 系统将电解氢与空气捕集 CO₂ 连成甲烷生产，属于碳利用与储能路线。企业披露的系统运行、产品纯度和成本可用于理解工艺，但只有符合原规则的设备合同才对应此市场；甲烷燃烧会释放碳，也不能将该路线的销售或曲线解释成 MOF 永久碳移除进展。

Electrolytic hydrogen and air-captured CO₂ feed Sabatier methane synthesis, a utilization/energy-storage route. Company operating, purity and cost claims explain the process; only qualifying equipment contracts meet this market. Combustion releases carbon, so neither sales nor odds establish MOF-based durable removal.
gap: 原文允许签约未交付，且只接受特定大部件；示范系统、产品销售与设备销售需要独立核验。
Contracting without delivery is allowed only for specified major components; demonstration, fuel and equipment sales need separate verification.

title: Sabatier 甲烷化：碳利用与永久移除
Sabatier methanation: utilization and durable removal
principle: Sabatier 反应可写作 CO₂ + 4H₂ → CH₄ + 2H₂O。把空气中的碳变成甲烷可储存电能，但燃烧会使碳回到大气；全生命周期是否减排，还取决于供电、甲烷泄漏与设备运行。
The Sabatier reaction is CO₂ + 4H₂ → CH₄ + 2H₂O. Methane stores energy, but combustion returns carbon to the atmosphere; lifecycle emissions depend on power, leakage and operation.
example: Terraform 2024 年披露的是系统接通、运行与成本主张。本题只接受反应器或完整碳浓缩器的大部件销售/租售合同，不要求当年交付，且明确排除仅卖甲烷的情况；因此示范成功与平台 No 可以同时成立。

Terraform’s 2024 post reports an integrated demonstration and costs. This contract instead needs sales/leasing of the reactor or complete concentrator, allows contracting without delivery, and excludes methane-only sales. A successful demonstration can coexist with platform No.

label: 设备合同并非燃料销售
Equipment contract versus fuel sale
detail: 只计符合用途的设备或完整大部件合同；允许签约未交付。
Only qualifying equipment/major-component contracts count; contracting without delivery is allowed.
